comments.body_html:
The VPO-209 is actually considered a “Shotgun” in russia since it’s smoothbore, i believe they made it like that so it’s more accessible, since getting a shotgun license in russia is easier than getting a rifle one.

Same with the MP-18, it’s smoothbore hence why it’s in the shotgun category.

The goal of this mod is to align internal category id with what displayed in handbook and wiki.

As example, Lone Star is listead as assault carbine absolutely everywhere. Except internally, where it’s listed as assault rifle.

Mp-18 is listed as shotgun everywhere therefore there’s nothing to fix
